_about: 2-31 (R1 fix 2): antiportal_958 (258, 132), scale 6, refuses within 192 px at 32 x scale, which
holds everything from x 66 to 450 at the ring's height; anti_portal_agent_ent_990 (294, 112) is
boxed in by platform_960, double_block_961 and single_block_1013, and fix 1's scan found no shot to
it from outside the ring - but a shot may leave from inside a field (fix2/check_2_31b.txt: 1,347
free points). A portal at (450, 30) on single_block_987 (217 px from the ring's centre) and one on
the player: up onto the blocks' tops; left along them to the very end of double_block_961 (centre x
279.8, sliding slowly off it); a shot from there toward (264.8, 180) passes about 1 px left of the
block's corner and 21.6 px from the agent (R17's 22.4) and kills it (187); the ring goes. A portal
at (198, 205) under platform_960 and one on the player, before he slides off into fire_agent_963's
flame (262): onto single_block_1010; a portal at (60, 90) over the door's ledge and one on the
player: into the door. Won on tick 298. Leans on two shots passing through fire_agent_963's flame
(13.8 and 2.2 px from it), which the original snuffs and the port does not (fire.json
_burn_projectile_not_built): the step that builds that re-verifies 2-31, and if the original snuffs
them 2-31 is a finding again; the stance on the block's corner (the port's capsule); G10; G4.
